content.title:
Hi stargazers! Tonight, check out the pretty waxing crescent #moon. It’ll hang low in the western sky soon after #sunset, close to brilliant #Venus. Start looking about 30 minutes after sunset. How soon can you spot our brightest planet? 🌒🌌

Find out more in this video:
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Tyk_2nODE2w

And for more sky events, visit EarthSky’s night sky guide:
https://earthsky.org/astronomy-essentials/visible-planets-tonight-mars-jupiter-venus-saturn-mercury/
